title: RE-Environment Ontology (REO) v1.0.0 and EC-RE reference checker
description: REO v1.0.0 is a reference implementation of an environment ontology and an executable derivation contract for requirements engineering. The package includes the ontology modules, SHACL validation shapes, the reference checker, a synthetic medical-emergency example, and the evaluation materials and results reported in the accompanying article.
